name: AI Addendum
description: Common Paper standard addendum that supplements a cloud or software agreement with terms governing AI services, including customer Input, generated Output, and restrictions on training models with customer data.

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: Common Paper standard HIPAA Business Associate Agreement setting out a provider's obligations for using, disclosing, and safeguarding protected health information (PHI) on behalf of a covered entity.

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: Common Paper standard agreement for selling and buying cloud software (SaaS), covering access and use, subscription periods, fees, confidentiality, warranties, and liability.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: Common Paper standard agreement giving an early design partner access to a product in development in exchange for feedback, covering access, feedback rights, confidentiality, and term.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Data Processing Agreement defining processor and subprocessor relationships, data protection obligations, security, and cross-border transfer terms for personal data under GDPR and similar laws.

name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement - Standard Terms
description: Common Paper Mutual NDA Standard Terms governing how each party may use and must protect the other's confidential information shared for a stated purpose.

name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement - Cover Page
description: Cover Page for the Common Paper Mutual NDA where the parties fill in the purpose, effective date, MNDA term, confidentiality term, governing law, jurisdiction, and signatures; incorporates the Mutual NDA Standard Terms.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: Common Paper standard agreement for business partnerships, covering each party's obligations, feedback, trademark licenses, confidentiality, and liability.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: Common Paper standard agreement for a limited-time product pilot or trial, letting a customer access and evaluate a product during a pilot period before committing to a full purchase.

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: Common Paper standard agreement for professional services delivered under Statements of Work (SOWs), covering services, deliverables, fees, intellectual property, and liability.

name: Service Level Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Service Level Agreement defining target uptime, support response times, and service credits available to a customer of a cloud service.

name: Software License Agreement
description: Common Paper standard agreement for licensing on-premise or installed software, covering the license grant, restrictions, subscription periods, fees, warranties, and liability.
